A white or almost white, crystalline powder or silky white or al- most white crystals. It sublimes readily. Sparingly soluble in wa- ter; freely soluble in boiling water; slightly soluble in dehydrated alcohol. It dissolves in concentrated solutions of alkali benzoates or salicylates. USP 31 (Caffeine). It is anhydrous or contains one molecule of water of hydration. An odourless white powder or white, glisten- ing needles, usually matted together. The hydrate is efflorescent in air. The hydrate is soluble 1 in 50 of water, 1 in 75 of alcohol, 1 in 6 of chloroform, and 1 in 600 of ether. The hydrate should be stored in airtight containers. Stability.
